svg.text: bypass_rb: the bypass capacitors of vcm and vref, in a cell of their own
Christoph, 2026-11-07: distinct from vcm_rb and vref_s2d_rb, "6 on vref, 4 on vcm". All 12u x 12u hv NMOS to vss, the s2d
pad's load-capacitor device (CLP / CLN). vcm_rb keeps its CB (the buffer's phase margin); vref_s2d_rb has none (no loop).
NMOS to vss only: PMOS to iovdd couples iovdd into vref, the S2D's zero point (explore_bypass.py).
parameters ncm (default 4), ncr (default 8): the number of capacitors on vcm and vref. Drawn from netlist/source/pad_ref_rb.spice (subckt bypass_rb)
